abstract.p: An apparatus including: a left-ventricular assist device (20) configured to assist left-ventricular functioning of a subject, the left-ventricular assist device comprising: a tube (24) configured such that a proximal portion of the tube is disposed in an aorta of the subject and a distal portion of the tube (24) is disposed within a left ventricle of the subject, the tube (24) defining a set of one or more blood-inlet openings (108) at a distal end of the tube, and a set of one or more blood-outlet openings (109) within the proximal portion of the tube; a frame (34) disposed within the distal portion of the tube, the frame being configured to hold the distal portion of the tube in an open state, the frame not being disposed within the proximal portion of the tube, and the proximal portion of the tube thereby being configured to collapse inwardly in response to pressure outside of the proximal portion of the tube exceeding pressure inside the proximal portion of the tube; an impeller (50) disposed within the frame (34) and configured to pump blood through the tube from the subject's left ventricle to the subject's aorta, by pumping the blood into the tube via the one or more blood-inlet openings and by pumping blood out of the tube via the one or more blood-outlet openings, wherein the tube (24) is configured such that during pumping of the blood through the tube (24) the proximal portion of the tube (24) is maintained in an open state, and wherein the tube (24) is pre-shaped such that during pumping of the blood through the tube (24) at least a portion of the tube becomes curved.
